timeline.summary: Jindal Poly Films submitted a revised Limited Review Report for Q3FY26 clarifying auditor header formatting oversight.
SEBI issued a Show Cause Notice to Jindal Poly Films and key management personnel regarding governance and disclosure matters.
NCLT allowed M/s Monet Securities Pvt Ltd to replace original lead applicants in an ongoing minority shareholder petition against Jindal Poly Films.
Jindal Poly Films shareholders passed both ordinary resolutions (material related-party transactions and put option) by postal ballot
Jindal Poly Films delayed the board approval and filing of Q4 and FY26 financial results citing resource movement following a May 2025 fire incident.
Promoters and Persons Acting in Concert (PAC) of Jindal Poly Films Limited, including Concatenate Flexi Films Advest Private Limited, confirmed no encumbrance on shares as of March 31, 2026.
Jindal Poly Films informed that its appeal before the Supreme Court against the NCLAT order was verified on June 5, 2026.
